title: Industrial Design Internship (Stuttgart)
note: Six-month compulsory (for-credit) internship for industrial/product design students.

facts.summary: Six-month internship on the design team at TEAMS' Stuttgart-Esslingen studio, starting March 2027.
facts.duties: Take part across the process: user research, product concepts, 2D/3D design data and model making with Rhino, KeyShot, Photoshop, Miro and Procreate.
facts.requirements: Industrial/product design student starting a required internship; strong sketching, visualization and form skills.
facts.apply: Email motivation letter, CV and process portfolio (PDF up to 15MB or link), or use the form on the page.
